limits: Real isolated Edge with actual source queue/export modules. HTTP sync acknowledgements are controlled synthetic fixtures. Does not establish authenticated server or PostgreSQL concurrency acceptance.

tests.name: 225 IndexedDB marks drain in chronological 50/50/50/50/25 batches without touching another owner
Malformed acknowledgements retain every mark for retry
Version conflicts remain unresolved while independent marks drain
Two browser tabs share the Web Lock and do not double-send marks
Account change during an in-flight batch stops subsequent sends and preserves the rest
Legacy version-2 IndexedDB marks survive migration in nonretryable quarantine
Stored minutes payloads render as text without script, image, or event-handler execution
